description:
Sung Ho’s not the kind you’d typically expect to settle down in the countryside. He’s in his late 20s, ex-military, and…a single father with a year-old baby his ex-girlfriend pawned off on him. Jobless and without any prospects but a house, Sung Ho hopes the peaceful Nuldongmae village will make a good new home for him and his daughter. Rumor has it that the head of the village, despite his young age, is a real jerk… But he won’t have to deal with that, will he? But on the very day he moves in, Sung Ho clashes with a tall, good-looking guy who’s got quite the temper and accuses Sung Ho of stealing from his store. This new guy really gets on his nerves, but he does seem to know a lot about the village… Sung Ho’s always been a bit of a lone ranger wherever he goes, so will he be able to let someone else in his life for sunny days up ahead? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Ed Rothstaylor is a third-rate villain in a game, disowned by his family and kicked out of the dormitory for his misdeeds. One day, our main character wakes up as this very Ed, and realizes he must earn a scholarship so he can graduate and be set for life. Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game! Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
After a stalking incident, Yoon Ji-gu has become understandably wary of strangers. So when an odd man moves in next door, he immediately suspects the worst. Little does he know, Yeowoon is just a regular guy trying to land a job and enjoy his free time—until he finds himself dealing with a hostile neighbor. As their real-life misunderstandings escalate, the two unknowingly team up in their favorite online game, forming an unexpected duo. Get ready to log in to a new adventure full of hilarious mix-ups, a distrustful tsundere, and an unwitting flirt with a heart of gold.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Season 2 is rated R19.*

titles.title: เพียงรุ่งอรุณ

description:
School is home to judgmental eyes and home a source of abuse. But that's ok because Junyeong Yun found an abandoned home where she could study to her heart's content. Unfortunately, soon after, Beomjin Kwon, the town's most notorious delinquent, has also begun using the home to catch up on sleep. As the two are forced to coexist, they come to learn about their reasons for avoiding others. 

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

The so-called “Lighthouse of the North,” the prosperous trading town of Schoarra, hides a dark underbelly: seedy slums ruled by five ruthless crime bosses. When streetwise orphan Vlad finds the brothel he works for decimated by a disgraced knight, he turns to the path of the blade, pledging himself to the pursuit of power by sword. Blessed with the ability to seek wisdom from his sentient sword, Vlad embarks upon a journey of growth and peril as swordsman in service to the powerful House Vayezid.

(Source: WEBTOON)

As soon as he opens the gate, however, he suddenly sees a message that says his tutorial has been completed and finds himself in the body of Bjorn Yandel, a real barbarian within the game. An exciting adventure awaits him as he endeavors to abide by the laws of the fictional world!

Raised to kill like a pack of loyal hounds, the Baskerville children took countless lives as a band of fearsome assassins. Despite being the shunned illegitimate son of the brood, Vikir served his family faithfully, only to meet his untimely demise at his father’s hands. But when he is inexplicably reborn with a second chance at life, Vikir, armed with the memories and knowledge of his past, swears to rise above the pack and take his revenge. This time, he’s ready to bite the hand that feeds.

*Source: Tapas*

----

The children of the Baskerville family are trained as loyal hounds from a young age, knowing nothing apart from a life of death and deception. After faithfully serving his family for forty years, Vikir Von Baskerville was rewarded with betrayal and execution by the hands of the man he called his father. But when he’s given a second chance at life by being reborn with his memories of his past life intact, Vikir swears to have his revenge against the family he once served. Once again, he must survive the brutal life that awaits all the hounds of Baskerville, but this time he vows to bite the hand that feeds him.

*Source: Yen Press, Vol. 1*

Se-Jun, your average Seoul underdog, didn’t expect to grow tomatoes full-time when he stumbled into the mysterious dungeon full of monster quests and extravagant rewards. Yet, there he was, as a farmer growing and selling cash crops while clearing numerous quests that came his way. Will Se-Jun make it out of the dungeon with the plush rewards he hoped for? At least he has what it takes: optimism, resourcefulness, and a group of loyal furry friends. 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

description:
When Su-Na Choi wakes up in the body of the villainess Edith Rigelhof, she’s confident that she’s got this! After all, she knows how this is typically supposed to go: A girl dies, reincarnates into a romance novel as the villainess, uses her wits and foreknowledge to avoid death, and lives happily ever after (and maybe even wins over a hot guy or two). Except...saying that things aren’t working out as she’d hoped would be putting it lightly. Killian Rudwick, her new husband and the second male lead, seems hellbent on finding every reason under the sun to despise her, and any attempt to fix her reputation appears to be futile. It’s almost as if some higher power is refusing to let her change Edith's place in the narrative—but with her life on the line, she must find a way to break the story’s hold before it’s too late!

(Source: Ize Press)

*Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.*

Luke is having a rough time in college, and his breakup with his girlfriend Stacy is not helping. This is all because of that nerdy stud, Andrew! If only Stacy didn't obsess over Andrew's dorky charms, then Luke wouldn't have had to break their relationship off! To make matters worse, Luke is then forced to live in the same dorm room as Andrew! But with nowhere else to go and no money to his name, Luke resolves to make it his project to befriend Andrew, whether the nerd likes it or not! 

(Source: Tapas)

But the Baengri estate was a den of vipers that swallowed her whole, and it's only when she's standing at the funeral of the father she never truly understood that she realizes how familiar this story is. When she wakes up six years old again, Yeon knows she can't waste her second chance. This time, she's going to save her father. This time, she's going to live without regrets.

description:
The world was embroiled in a death game involving individuals from ages 15 to 29. Thrown into a game devoid of empathy and compassion, Min Ryu had no choice but to fight for his survival. For the 99th time, he finally made it to the end of the game. Standing alone in front of the final boss’s chamber, Min Ryu was greeted with betrayal as the system killed him for not having four more players with him. On his 100th and final attempt, can Min Ryu find the help he needs to end this ruthless game?

(Source: Tapas)

description:
Seong-Un Choi is the top-ranked player in the game "Lost World," being the only player to have completed all its achievements. However, his triumph is short-lived as a mysterious message transports him to the real "Lost World," transforming him from a mere gamer to a contender for godhood. Amidst others vying for divinity, will Seong-Un be able to achieve true godhood and reign supreme in this new realm?

(Source: WEBTOON)

All’s fair in love and war. Two couples will need to battle it out for love and money! But who knew they’d swap partners before doing so? Tae-Rin and Ju-A are both friends and studying fashion at the same university. So why is Ju-A going on a couple’s show with Tae-Rin’s boyfriend? And why is Tae-Rin going on the same show with Ju-A’s boyfriend?!

description:
After devoting his life to the crime organization, Glory Club, Peter retires his status as a legendary killer and spends his remaining days running a quiet used bookstore. But after being ambushed and nearly killed one day by the very organization he dedicated his life to, Peter finds his body magically reverted back to its teenage years. Now that Peter was back to his peak physique, he sets out to settle the score with Glory Club.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Despite the war raging between the North and South, Margaret is a northerner who holds an unwavering love for her southern lover, Squall... until he cruelly betrays her and pushes her off a seaside cliff. Just when she's about to drown, the voice of a mysterious witch offers her a second chance at life. However, this chance only comes to her seven years later, when she rises from the ocean in a new body without a voice. Although Margaret receives help from a local apothecary named Jack, the other southern villagers aren't as eager to let an outsider into their fold... 

(Source: Tappytoon) 

*Note: The chapter count includes 2 epilogue chapters.*

titles.title: Turning～新しい未来をこの手に～

description:
*"I thought I had lost my future forever... But the moment I realized that it had returned to me, my hands trembled with both joy and wonder."* 

Yudrein Ail is a commoner who was bestowed with powers on the night the Red Stone fell. He is also the first omega to rise to the rank of Imperial Trooper, but was accused of a crime he didn’t commit and executed soon after - only to reawaken eleven years ago, before the war began. He can't repeat the mistakes of his past…to survive is to save the world. But in order to do so, he must prevent the man he killed from facing his inevitable death. 

*"The future won't be the same. I'll make sure of it."* 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: The Player With a Hidden Past

The real world is suddenly ambushed by rifts that threaten to spill out monsters from the VR game “Chronicles of Arcana.” These rifts can only be closed by “players,” people who have awakened as their in-game characters with all the same stats and skills. Unfortunately for protagonist Lee Ho-Yeol, his awakening is the opposite of cool as his avatar happens to be the one he made during the height of his awkward phase in middle school, giving him all the mannerisms and speech of an absolute cringelord. Just how will he go on to become the hero humanity needs most? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Actress Lee Sia hasn't just been haunted by ghosts for years, she's also been plagued by dreams of a girl named Camilla Sorphel dying repeatedly at the hands of her stepfather and stepbrother. Despite her efforts to ignore the dreams, when an accident at work makes her wake up as Camilla, she's forced to seek the help of various ghosts to win over her family and avoid getting killed. But can this former actress play the part of a loving daughter and sister to her future executors? 

(Source: Tapas)

Even though it has beautiful graphics, its player base dubbed it as one of the worst games due to how difficult it is. You play the game as Adrian—a fine young man who’s also the devil’s reincarnation. Your goal as Adrian is to kill as many people as possible because of Lilith’s Curse. One night, you played the game until you couldn’t anymore and found yourself waking up as Hilda, one of Adrian’s maids… 

(Source: Tapas)

description:
Tired of the yoke of the Divine Justice Alliance, master assassin Cheon Ha-Jin attempts to flee, only to be confronted by martial artists of all allegiances, both orthodox and deviant. Succumbing to the wounds of his ferocious struggle for freedom, he awakens in the body of Seo Ryang, a prince of the notorious Heavenly Demon Cult who suffers from a disorder that prohibits him from the use of qi. In order to survive in his new life, Ha-Jin must contend with the many dangers and enemies that lurk within the cult.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

titles.title: レガス ～僕と呪われた王子～

description:
Blessed with dragon's blood, a royal is born every generation with the creature's legendary might. But with that might comes a dragon's cruelty. Thus, each royal is assigned a Regas, a dragon tamer capable of quelling the raging hearts of those with the dragon's blessing. Abel has been trained in the ways of a Regas, but can he withstand the lunacy of the latest blessed prince? 

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: Draw a Line Between Public and Private Lives
โปรดแยกแยะเรื่องงานกับเรื่องส่วนตัว!

description:
Baek Dohu’s a university student who writes BL novels on the side. And his preferred type of top character? The scumbag kind, who treats their partners like crap. And Dohu’s first impression of Seo Juheon is the complete opposite: the typical nice-guy—always smiling, always catering to the needs of those around him. But things take a turn when he accidentally comes across Juheon blackmailing someone in an alley. The real Juheon is a polar opposite from the facade he puts up; he swears, he has a temper, he’s manipulative…and Dohu loves it. Juheon could be THE inspiration for his next big novel that hit a dead end long ago. Excited, Dohu starts following Juheon around “observing” his character, which is bound to give Juheon some wrong ideas… Between the lines of artist and muse, business and pleasure, who’ll be the first to cross the line over to the other side? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: แม่บ้านแห่งดันเจี้ยน

description:
Tired, overworked Hui-Na thinks dungeons and Hunters have nothing to do with her until she's suddenly gifted with a Hunter's abilities. Now she has to navigate her game-like reality with the skills and stats of... a Homemaker?! With this class, Hui-Na becomes the ultimate cook, custodian, and caretaker, which lands her a seemingly harmless job in a Hunter guild. But will this organization help Hui-Na bring the Hunters a revolution of rest or force her into dangers she'd never dreamed of? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

description:
Cha-Yeong Mun had the perfect life -- a peaceful life in the countryside with a loving husband, three cats who run the house, and two dogs who think they’re cats. One day, she goes into the city to meet her friends and dies while saving a student from being hit by a truck. The god in the afterlife gives her the incredibly rare chance to go back to her wonderful life, but only under the condition of going back 10 years in time. Given the second chance, Will she be able to marry her husband again and rebuild that perfect life she knew? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

titles.title: Dreadful Night รัตติกาลสยองท่องเกมมรณะ

description:
Wanna play a game? The only catch is, you’re not just playing it, you’ve got to play your way out of it. That’s exactly what is happening to Bada. And he’s been at this for a while, trying to gather clues and items to find a way out of this damn horror RPG. The killer, the NPCs, the setting, Bada’s now familiar with them all. He’ll just have to endure a couple more games, maybe get killed a few more times… But in this session, Nam Doha, someone who Bada thought was just an NPC, is suddenly acting strange. Has he been another player this entire time? Bada has to be tortured to end this storyline and start over and Doha has volunteered to do it, but the look in his eyes suggests he has other, even more sinister intentions in mind… 

What sadistic horrors must Bada endure to break free from this Dreadful Night? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

A young aspiring chef suddenly finds himself in a world of war, dragons, and magic. These two worlds couldn’t be further apart... or could they? Who says you can’t open a restaurant in a fantasy realm? I mean, what could possibly go wrong? A perfect series for fantasy, magic, and food lovers.

(Source: WEBTOON)

With her outstanding business acumen, Min-Gyeong Kang climbed the corporate ranks of TK Group, Korea’s top conglomerate, to become a senior manager in record time. But after 10 years at the company, she’s been assigned to be the secretary of I-Seop Tae, the successor to TK Group. The two entered the company at the same time, but ever since he came second place to her at new employee training, I-Seop’s never taken kindly to Min-Gyeong. She’s better than him in every way and trampled all over his ego… so why can’t he stop thinking about her? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Now, she believes that she's an imposter and that the real princess will take her rightful place, leading to the execution of Philomel the Fake! So to avoid a tragic death, she has to make sure the rest of the book doesn't come true. Can this fake princess change what's already been written?

Hae-Beom is often mistaken for a gangster due to his stern appearance. Sang-A, a customer who helped Hae-Beom, is a mermaid. Sang-A needs human saliva in order to get legs, so Hae-Beom selflessly offers a kiss... Once a day, every day.

Jean Erhardt debuted in Joachim Empire as a successful capitalist infamous for buying his noble title. Despite his seemingly innocent intentions, Jean yearned to spark a revolution from within high society. But first, he must gain a powerful friend. A chance encounter with Maximilian, the hedonistic Crown Prince of Joachim, presented Jean with one such auspicious ally. This proved tricky as Maximilian knew of Jean’s past as an escort and the prince hungered for Jean’s return to decadence…

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

titles.title: รักไร้แรงโน้มถ่วง
無重力ロマンス〜妊娠してみるか？地球人〜

description:
Some people win the lottery or find their dream job, but Sohan…has an alien spaceship land on his brand-new house?! To make matters even worse, there’s an – admittedly sexy – alien inside threatening to wipe out the entire population. Sihwa has come to earth in search of someone specific and has no qualms about using Sohan to get what he wants. It's well-known that living with one's mother-in-law is basically hell. So marrying a poor merchant with no family should be an easy way to avoid that mess, right? Well, that was Elaen's plan until she realizes that her husband, Ahen, lied to her, and is actually the son of the empire's ferocious Grand Wizard, Kanessis Corenea, who she'll have to live with at her palace! Though intimidated at first, Elaen realizes that Kanessis is nothing like the figures in mother-in-law horror stories, and becomes enamored with her charisma and unexpected kindness. If anything, the problem here is Ahen's ulterior motives for marrying Elaen, which she only discovered after the fact. Since ancient times, fairies have existed to maintain balance in the world, each governing a fundamental human desire - wealth, pleasure, appetite, rest, and honor. Pence, a money fairy with an insatiable thirst for riches, was poised to become the next ruler of the fairy realm. But his greed came at a cost. When he exploits his powers at the expense of others, he is cast out and stripped of his status, forced to live among humans. Now stranded in the mortal world, Pence crosses paths with Yoo-Jin, a relentless workaholic struggling to make ends meet. But old habits die hard, and Pence's schemes for easy wealth quickly backfire. As karma catches up to him, he’s about to learn the true cost of greed—and what it really means to earn one’s fortune.

Hopeless in her own imprisonment, Niobe ends her life only to be returned to the past–exactly two years before her marriage with Valon. With the second chance at life, Niobe is determined to conceal and protect her true love.

Set to wed the crown prince, Annette’s life was looking rosy. But rumors and scandals followed that ruined her life. In the end, she ended up marrying the bastard son of the emperor, Raphael. Two black sheep of their respective families together in a bitter arranged marriage. Left weak and frail from her life’s trials and tribulations, she prays to any god who will listen, that if given one more chance, she’d fix everything. Well, Annette’s wish has been granted. Reborn, five years in the past, on the day before her wedding, she can now relive her life and make things right. But will Annette fall into the same traps as before or will this be her royal redemption?

As their paths continue to cross, will they end up fighting until the very end? Or will there be a more... pleasant ending for them both?

When her best friend Mi-yo offers her a place to stay while she gets back on her feet, Eunseo only ever intends to rest for a while before getting out of her hair. The problem is, Eunseo’s demons have come looking for her much sooner than she was expecting, and she soon finds herself facing one in particular. Kang Mido may be somewhat happy that she’s back, but he sure isn’t happy about her leaving in the first place. Determined to stop her from running away again, Mido resorts to drastic measures. Eunseo is in a predicament, there’s no doubt about that, but you know what they say: better the devil you know…

So when Aslan brings another woman into their home, Helena leaves so he can be happy. Or at least, that’s the plan until Aslan gets into an accident trying to chase after her! Lee Hwan, the protagonist of a web novel, receives a once-in-a-lifetime offer from a god: help said god create his web novel in return for a wish. After agreeing to this deal, Hwan is thrown into a modern world filled with fantasy elements, new technology, and martial artists. All he needs to do is follow the plotline the author set out for him, except... there is no concrete plotline! With such a plot hole, can Hwan manage to come up with a story detailed and cool enough to appease its creator?

Julitan bestows her with the name Carnelian, only to accidentally awaken a powerful "sille" being. But Carnelian the sille soon discovers her new tamer and master Sir Julitan is no match for her superior power. Now the two must embark on a long quest to find this fierce sille dragon's true knight!

Legend says that a being stronger than any other, a being feared by both angels and demons, a being completely OVER THE TOP (aka OTT) will be awakened in the near future. But our average high school boy Jae-Ik doesn’t care much for this legend... until he turns 19 and members of Heaven and Hell desperately attempt to win him over. Will our soon-to-be fearsome (and uninterested) OTT be able to pick a side? Well, we'll see once the dust of the recruiting war settles.

Once thriving but now facing financial ruin, Jang Solbi becomes the secretary of Choi Seokyoon, the chairman of a powerful corporation. Grateful for the support during her family's hardship, she works tirelessly to repay their debt. However, following the loss of her parents, Solbi uncovers the dark truth behind their tragedy and seeks revenge against Chairman Choi. After years spent working for him, the moment finally arrives, yet her plans are foiled by Choi's son, Leehwan. Even after witnessing Solbi's hatred towards his father, Leehwan proposes a disturbing deal: comply with him, and he'll overlook her attempted murder. Despite her initial repulsion, Solbi reluctantly accepts, hoping for a second chance. As time passes, she discovers an unexpected attraction to Leehwan. Is her interest mere curiosity, or is this evolving relationship destined to become something deeper?

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Defeated in war, Geon-Mu, a former emperor, loses all power and is taken as a prisoner by the enemy nation. Stripped of dignity and freedom, he is forced to become the personal plaything of the beautiful yet merciless, Yeon-Hwa. Yeon-Hwa, who once forcefully claimed Geon-Mu’s body, now seeks to control every aspect of his life—his movements, his thoughts, even his emotions. And yet, each night, the emperor weeps, asking if Geon-Mu has truly forgotten him, whispering confessions of love through trembling lips.

 *“Your Majesty... you are beautiful.”*

But Geon-Mu can no longer tell if the turmoil in his heart is hatred or something far more dangerous. As the line between enemy and lover begins to blur, Geon-Mu is left questioning: Is this agony the product of betrayal… or the weight of a love that should never have existed?

(Source: Lezhin US)

I had a dream last night. I can’t seem to remember it... yet I feel like it was very important. Dreams connect us to others, to ourselves, to the past, present, and future. Dreams about you, dreams about me, and dreams about us. Dreams that seem far away yet will always remain in my heart. Dreams about dreams that are just one touch away from reality. As she tries to gather her thoughts, she can’t wrap her head around the situation—she just had a one-night stand with a guy who used to be just a kid in her eyes. Five years ago, Minjun, the neighborhood high schooler, confessed his feelings to her, but she didn’t take him seriously. Now, he’s back, no longer a boy, but a man. After a chance encounter at a bar, Jiyeon reconnects with Minjun, who is now a bartender. As their past connection resurfaces, Jiyeon is torn between the memories of the boy he was and the man he's become. Minjun is determined not to lose her this time, and Jiyeon must come to terms with the fact that he’s no longer the playful kid—he’s grown up and ready for something real.

Roselaine married Grand Duke Melchior, the best knight in the Empire. He said it’s because, “I want to save you.” Roselaine can only respond, “You don’t know anything about me.”

A man who wants to save her life, save her family, pay off her debts, and even marry her? They say there’s no such thing as a favor without any strings attached, so why would he go this far for someone he doesn’t even know?

“Because you look like someone I knew.” Roselaine evidently looks just like Melchior’s first love.

While depressed because she thinks she is only a stand-in for his first love, Roselaine takes in Julian, who looks exactly like her husband’s childhood self, as her disciple. But then Julien asks, “Please divorce him and marry me, Roselaine.”

Though respected in his field, as a branch family member, everything he’s built could be taken away with a single word from the main bloodline. Then one day, a command arrives:

 *“Protect the Sa Clan’s direct heirs.”*

Summoned before the clan head, Dan-Bok is handed a file. Inside—two names, two photos, and two absurdly beautiful faces that look more like artwork than people. But looks can be deceiving. These aren't fragile ornaments—

After years of devotion, Si-Woo’s boyfriend betrays him; then, the company he worked so hard at goes under. Feeling totally defeated, Si-Woo escapes into a game world just to take a break from reality. There, he meets a newbie named Woo-Jin, whose kind advice and hard-working attitude inspire Si-Woo to move on from his past and start living with purpose again. Determined never to fall for someone who’ll hurt him again, Si-Woo makes a vow to his friend: No love, no dating. Ever again! But when he meets his new boss, Si-Woo’s willpower will be put to the ultimate test…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

When he is just one step away from finally getting his revenge, Chairman Kang suddenly dies. Nagi’s quest for vengeance turns to Chairman Kang’s son, Ho-Su. Will Nagi succeed or will an unexpected speedbump throw a wrench in his plans?

Young Kane is an orphan boy who doesn’t have a penny to his name. He has to resort to petty theft just to get some bread to eat. But out of nowhere appears a mysterious man, Shane White, who promises to take him in and become his adoptive father. Together, they go to the remote island where Shane and his other adopted children live. But this whole thing is definitely odd enough to raise Kane’s suspicions… Still, perhaps finally having a family and living on this idyllic island is enough to overcome all that. Even so, Kane can’t help but wonder just who this Shane is and what his actual intentions are…

Desperate to keep her happy, he makes a drastic choice and agrees to allow another man into her life. But what begins as a physical arrangement spirals into something far darker. He never agreed to give her heart away. Now, he must fight to reclaim not just his wife, but the love he’s slowly losing. Will it be too late to undo what’s already been set in motion?

Pet humans are kept for the amusement of the gods. While other gods treat their pet humans as mere toys, Ouranos takes a more loving and compassisonate approach to rearing his “companion human,” as he calls them. But when Ouranos is called out of town for a long period of time, he has no choice but to leave his pet human in the care of Erebos, the god of darkness. Erebos finds the human’s spoiled attitude dispicable and decides to teach him a few lessons…

Nari is living her best life as a beautiful, wealthy university student on the prowl for hotties with her best friend, Miyeon. The pair live by Miyeon’s golden rule: don’t sleep with anyone at school. But Nari is having trouble abiding… When she accidentally hooks up with a junior from her university, the damage is done, right? What’s the harm in doing it again with another guy… or two? It was a silly rule anyway, right?

(Source: Tapas)

Years later, following Soo-yi’s divorce, Yeonha's unwavering love for her remains unchanged and he sets out to make his beloved noona aware of how deep his feelings truly are. As time passes, Soo-yi finds herself slowly but surely consumed by the fiery passion of Yeonha's love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ian Han, a hunter burdened by a lifetime of neglect due to his inability to wield mana, now stood on the verge of death.

As regret consumed him, he lamented, "If I had known things would end up like this, I would’ve never made such a choice..."

Yet, in that desperate moment, something inexplicable occurred. Confusion gripped him as he questioned, "What is...?"

A sequence of messages started to echo in his mind.

[You have awakened.]

[You have cleared the tutorial.]

[As a reward for clearing the tutorial, you will be given a unique trait.]

One thing is clear—Angelica won’t commit the same mistakes again. 

*“I don’t love you anymore, Dominic. Let’s break off the engagement!”*

(Source: Tapas)

Though Jae-I can feel that something is off, the two seem somehow drawn to each other.

A man who seems poetic and refined on the surface but harbors a dark side, and a former gangster determined to turn over a new leaf and live a calmer, more meaningful life, cross paths. Axe was once the best player in "Ryn Online," an action-packed fantasy RPG. But when his comrades kill him, Axe is forced to start all over. Devastated by their betrayal, he swore off gaming and opened a fried chicken shop to make ends meet. But when a new VR game called "Fate" is released, he notices that the friends who betrayed him are also playing. Now, he's willing to go back to gaming and munch on chicken-fried monsters to get stronger for his revenge!

Now, she has a collapsing marriage, two children, and a host of strange decisions to unravel and figure out why she ended up here!

When Rin Na made her debut in pro baseball, she immediately became the most promising rookie in the league. But when she failed to meet everyone’s expectations, her rising star fell and was forgotten. With many regrets in her heart, Rin could only watch as her former teammates continued their successful careers. Her dream was over. Determined to survive, Iris resolves to befriend Theo in hopes of reforming him while he's still young. At first, everything seems to go according to plan... Woo-Shin Joo’s answer was to end his life so he could finally rest. Now, he wanders around as a spirit. Meanwhile, his body is kept alive by his wealthy parents who have hired a handsome medium, I-Rok, to find him and bring his soul back. Can I-Rok get Woo-Shin home and exorcise the spirit who haunts him? And more importantly, will Woo-Shin ever rest?

From then on, Valenti vows to become the lady in waiting to the so-called monster prince, to escape her horrendous past life's fate, and to hold up the prince as the nation's true emperor for her beloved country. After graduating summa cum laude as a lady in training, she chooses not to accept the prized fate of becoming an attendant to the empress, but to the one individual nobody would want to support. As they face one mystery after another, how will Zena and Siu ever debut together?

Everything seems to be going smoothly until a message suddenly appears before her eyes. “Dear Lorella Mayred, congratulations on becoming a heroine candidate!” If she fails to become the final heroine, she’ll be wiped from existence and the memories of everyone who knows her. Three years ago, Han Seo-Jun walked away from both the stage and the man he loved. To the public, he was nothing more than “the decent supporting role standing next to actor Choi Seung-Hyeon.” To Seo-Jun, the humiliation of being overshadowed by his partner, and the pain of leaving him behind, was enough to end his career altogether. Now, at 29, Seo-Jun’s world is far removed from the spotlight. He waits tables at a bar, scraping by on wages that disappear into debts and the money he dutifully sends to his parents in the countryside. His dreams are long buried, his heart heavier than his empty wallet. And then Seung-Hyeon appears again. Not as a memory, but in the flesh, standing in Seo-Jun’s workplace, urging him to act on stage once more. 

The man he loved. The career he abandoned. Both return at once, reopening wounds Seo-Jun thought would never bleed again.

Even though their marriage is contractual, I-Jae feels an intense attraction for the cold and calculating Yu-Heon. Every night in her dreams, she imagines what it would be like to make love with him… until one day, the two end up actually sharing a passionate night together. But will their physical chemistry be enough to build a genuine connection? Or will I-Jae remain a pawn in Yu-Heon’s game?

To flee from her abusive family, Evelyn Diego pretends to be a goddess from a prophecy and tricks the blind Grand Duke Devan Lantimos into believing she can lift his curse. Unfortunately, her powers fail to heal him completely, and things get even more complicated as she discovers that Devan's curse isn't quite what she thought it was. With time running out and her family looking for her, will Evelyn be able to cure Devan and get the freedom she so desperately wants? 

(Source: Tapas)

description:
Lim Sohee is the envy of all. As the youngest professor at Jaelim University and the fiancée of the heir to the global pharmaceutical giant Venon, she is also a stunning royal omega. Her future seemed perfectly set as she prepared for her upcoming wedding. But during a secluded trip with her fiancé, an unexpected heat cycle hits. For three days and nights, Sohee is consumed by primal instincts, unaware of the passing time. When she finally comes to her senses and turns on her phone, she is met with over a hundred missed calls from her fiancé. Confused, she realizes something has gone terribly wrong. Wait, if her fiancé is the man lying in bed next to her... why would he have called her so many times? Who is he really?

*“Oh, did I forget to introduce myself?”

“What…?”

“Remember me? Gu Jigyeom, Gu Jihun’s twin brother.”*

Tears well up in Sohee’s eyes as the shocking truth sinks in. Jigyeom, who had already marked and knotted Sohee, whispers softly while gently caressing her earlobe.

*“Don’t cry. It’s too late, Sohee.”*

She has become another alpha's omega. Just five days before her wedding, she has been claimed by her fiancé’s twin brother.

One of these survivors, Park Tae-Yi, is now Korea's most famous and scandalous actress who only lives for the present. The other survivor, Jung Ha-Won, is a traumatized recluse afraid of the present. And after the two meet coincidentally on the way to Jeju Island, they find themselves constantly running into each other. But can these chance encounters pave a path for them to face the future together?

(Source: Tapas)

Praying to the gods he doesn’t think exist, no one is more surprised than he when a magpie swoops in to save the day. The man, Kang-Ho, claims to be a magpie sworn to protect him, but why does he have such a problem with the man next door? Sally begins to sabotage Sia at every turn, and as her hostility escalates, Sia starts to experience vivid visions of an ancient kingdom. In these visions, she encounters figures who eerily resemble Sally and Jeong Hyeok. As the echoes of a forgotten past rise to the surface, a story unfolds of long-buried memories, unfulfilled revenge, and a love that has endured through the ages.

(Source: Lezhin US)

With the start of senior year, high schooler Lee Yoeng-Won can't wait to graduate and leave his life of poverty behind. He only has to focus on studying so he can get into a good college. But suddenly, Mr. Popular, Yu Seon-U, who was never close to Yeong-Won, starts buying him food, helps him become class president, and even walks him home. Though Yeong-Won knows his top priority should be his grades, he begins to wonder why Seon-U is always the subject of his gaze...

(Source: Tapas, edited)

titles.title: Romance of the Four Guardian Gods
イケメン四神に狙われています

description:
Four guardian gods, one heart to win! 

Blessed with looks and talent, Su-Ji craves a quiet life—but four stunning boys, revealed as guardian gods of the cardinal directions, are determined to win her heart. With divine suitors on her tail, can Su-Ji stay under the radar while juggling their heavenly affections? 

(Source: Manta, edited)

titles.title: Giải Cứu Bé Thỏ Khỏi Tay Cá Mập

How to Get a Rabbit Out of a Shark
The Rabbit's Way in the Shark's Realm

从鲨鱼身边逃走的方法
從鯊魚身邊逃走的方法

description:
Galetocherdo, a fearsome serpent shark with an unexpected soft spot, falls head over fins at first sight for a rabbit statue and decides then and there that a bunny will one day become his mate. So when he stumbles upon a white “rabbit” fast asleep on the roadside, he doesn’t hesitate to bring it home. There’s just one problem. Virdo insists he’s not a rabbit at all, but a hermaphroditic sea slug, and he very much did not agree to becoming anyone’s bride. Trapped in an unfamiliar place and relentlessly courted by a forceful yet strangely sweet shark who refuses to take no for an answer, Virdo is pushed into a whirlwind of misunderstandings, identity chaos, and dangerously close proximity. As Galetocherdo demands “proof” and the line between obsession and affection blurs, Virdo must find a way to escape...or survive...this wildly inappropriate marine matchmaking. 

A high-energy monster rom-com featuring one stubborn shark, one very unlucky sea slug, and a sea full of misunderstandings, My Bunny Bride delivers four times the chaos and four times the trouble.

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

While working overseas, career woman Kang Min crosses paths with a charming Japanese man, Shibasaki Ken, during a chance encounter on the street. What was meant to be a one-night fling takes an unexpected turn when she runs into him again the next day—this time, at her workplace. This story explores the sweet, messy aftermath of a night that was supposed to mean nothing.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The year is 2030, and humanity is in its golden age of space exploration. Ju-Myeong is just your average high school student, but after Betelgeuse, a supergiant star, explodes in the sky, he starts noticing that things are not quite as they seem. A.I. starts acting strange, technology doesn’t work, and people’s memories are scrambled. Even Soh, his reclusive classmate, seems to have inhuman capabilities. Does she hold the answers to the mysteries of their school… and their world?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/61368814), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%B2%A0%ED%85%94%EA%B2%8C%EC%9A%B0%EC%8A%A4/3639)

[English](https://tapas.io/series/betelgeuse/info), [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/175290)

Hae-Su and Jin-Heon are childhood friends, but Hae-Su has a boyfriend and Jin-Heon is a gruff star athlete who just loves to tease her. After Hae-Su is dumped by her boyfriend Jeong-Un because she just doesn’t do it for him anymore, Hae-Su is understandably distraught and turns to Jin-Heon for a man’s perspective. Little does she know that her tearful bid for validation will spark a flame that could threaten their 13-year friendship…

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: 鬼の郎君様と結婚したい！

description:
500 years ago, the human and demon realms were divided, causing demons to all but fade from memory. That is, until young Lady Yeonri frees the King of the Dokkaebis, Mujin, from the seal that bound him. Grateful, Mujin pledges to protect Yeonri and bless her clan with eternal prosperity… but as Yeonri grows up with Mujin at her side, she realizes that there’s actually something more she’d like from him…

(Source: Tapas)

Bar S is an extraordinary bar run by three vibrant individuals: Goo Jun-Oh, a talented young chef; Go Yul, the magnetic bartender and manager; and Yoon Jung-Chan, a cheerful part-timer. Their group dynamic, though occasionally complicated, keeps the bar thriving—until the arrival of Ivan, a charming and enigmatic customer who stirs up emotions and rivalries within the group. His presence disrupts their balance, setting off a whirlwind of tension, passion, and intrigue, as the four navigate their intertwined relationships in this unique and captivating tale.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Excellent grades, good looks, above average fighting skills, and a sense of justice.
A first grade model student, Kim Hyunsung was pushed off a rooftop just before his graduation and became a vegetative patient. For ten years, he endured hellish days with only his hearing and consciousness intact, yet unable to die, he suddenly returns to the day when the bullying began.

Eunho, the strongest in the yokai realm!
He gained the chance to become a human being after losing the woman he loved and killing countless yokai.
After passing the gate of reincarnation by accumulating merit for a thousand years to abandon his immortal body…

He became a human being, held a sword, and learned martial arts for the first time.
But this is very… easy?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

Shin Kim is a special killer who gathered men from all over the country and made the organization "Baek-Yi" to destroy the absolute power "'Castle" of the underworld. Through a negotiation, he got inside Castle and started working with the enemy... Will Shin be able to take down Castle and complete his revenge as he hoped?

Min-Jun Kim, an ordinary high school senior in Korea, was suddenly summoned to another world, where he became a dark mage. However, before he could fully enjoy his life, a problem arose. A dungeon break had occurred and monsters came pouring out, threatening his comfortable days. Therefore, Min-Jun, who had just returned to earth, had no choice but to… enlist on the very next day!!!

After being killed by the organization he worked for, the infamous assassin Bi-Gwang is reincarnated as Kim Gyeong-Su, a police officer. He vows to take revenge on Hwaguksa, the organization of killers that betrayed him.

Kang Su-Hyeon, who has failed in everything he has done in life for four years. He finally found his calling as an actor and thought he was seeing the light, but he collided with a truck coming from the opposite side and despaired as death approached... 

“Wait a minute, didn’t I die?” 

When he regained consciousness, was his appearance reflected in the mirror the cutest version of himself from when he was 5 years old? 

*Yes, in this life I start as a child actor!*

Kang Su-Hyeon's acting career begins.

Jung Eon is a maid who works in the house of a rich and powerful family. She dreams of escaping a life of servitude and saves every penny she earns. One day, she receives an unexpected proposal from her childhood friend and boss, Hyun Mae-hwa. He's as pretty as a flower, but has a horrible personality. Mae-hwa says he wants to marry her because of a prophecy that says Jung Eon has six benefactors in his destiny. He thinks she is the source of his financial luck. She accepts, thinking it's a chance to change her life.

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

After giving up his dream of becoming a boxer, Park Kang-tae joined a gang. He was a well-known member of the gang but got killed in the end. His only dying regret is giving up his dream of being a boxer. Did God know about his regret? In a world where boxing exists in the form of pugilist games, Park Kang-tae pursues his unfulfilled dream. 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“Is there no place where a man can let out cries like a woman in ecstasy?”

Because of his family’s circumstances, Yeon-hu moves with his father to a rural village. Tricked by his older brother, he visits a courtesan house for the first time, where his delicate looks draw teasing and attention. It’s there he hears whispers about Do-hyeon, the village’s infamous “man-lover,” a notorious libertine. Yeon-hu never imagined such rumors would have anything to do with him—until Do-hyeon himself appears before him!

[Original Webtoon](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000061456)

In her childhood, Min-Ju was naturally talented, receiving praise for her abilities. However, her confidence takes a hit when she meets young Han-Sol. Feeling a twinge of jealousy and a sense of inferiority towards Han-Sol's talent, Min-Ju tries to keep her distance, but Han-Sol continues to approach her...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Do Janggon’ is a human weapon and forcer special forces spy against North Korea. When both of his arms got injured he was caught and brought to the ‘Daesan Welfare Center’, that abuses human rights and exploits labor. The doctor said it would take him a month to fully recover. So he has to hold out in the welfare center until his arms are healed.

description: With no savings, average qualifications, and a bank balance consistently below 10,000 won, can the Backbone Breaker Gye Baeksun really escape unemployment?

Top Idol and school bully switched bodies?! 

Hong Joo-Ah, a school bully who is bullied every day at school. Yo-Han, a top idol loved by the entire nation. Joo-Ah envies the life of a beloved idol, while Yo-Han envies the life of a normal, free person. One day, their bodies are switched! 

A spectacular body-swapping romance, Sasangdol!

Baek Yigang is a son of the Baek Clan, one of the seven great clans of Zhongyuan. Afflicted with the Taiyin Qi Blockage, he is cursed with a shortened lifespan and the inability to collect internal energy. He had been peacefully spending the rest of his days indoors when he was ambushed by a group of masked people. During the ambush, he lost his servant who was like a sister to him. Chased by the attackers, Baek Yigang escaped through a secret underground path. When he came across a blocked path, he decided he’d at least die fighting and picked up a rusted sword that was stuck in the ground… 

(Source: Naver, edited)

description:
Yun Ha-Jun, who struggled to pursue his musical career despite his iffy talents and ended up sacrificing his own family along the way.

"If only I could turn back time...! "

One day, after living with regrets and alcohol for a while, he woke up and found himself had returned to the past. Just then, it dawned on him.

*The fact that my younger sister is a musical genius...! Now is the time to turn my life around, by producing my younger sister into becoming the best singer!* 

(Source: Naver, translated)

นักเตะแข้งสวรรค์

Woo Ho-Young had dreamed of becoming a football player. However, he was not blessed with the talent and died without realizing his dream, struck by lightning. It was then that the demon Mammon appeared, offering the ability to covet everyone's talents...

(Source: Naver, translated)

The Cook of a Perished World
The Military Chef of a Ruined World

Doom came to Shin Young-jun, a cook sergeant, just a few days before his final vacation. The battalion turned into chaos in an instant, and the communication network was cut off. There is only one thing visible before your eyes! \[Congratulations on your awakening!\] \[Job: New Chef Lv.1\] If I had been a warrior or an assassin, I would have tried to stand alone... What was given to him was a chef, which is obviously a support job. There's nothing I can do when it's like this. 'From now on, I will feed you.' 

(Source: Naver, translated)

I don’t want to work. Like at all. But I don’t have a choice. On an Earth where Humans, Elves, Orcs, Trolls, Dragons, and Aliens live together, there is a never-ending series of incidents. This is the story of a man who's been working in secret for 800 years because he’ll die if he doesn’t.

\[You have collected the body of a “pathetic soldier.” Inheriting abilities.\] 

\[Inherited rewards: Stamina +1, Proficiency +1, Dehaman’s Armored Combat (D)\] 

I will see through to the end of this game no matter what! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

A new episode of the diary of desires that is back with even more spiciness. A desire that any human would have. What if it were to become reality? Would the end be happiness or destruction?

(Source: Naver, translated)

皇帝の剣〜絶対至尊への道〜

Zhu Yunwen, who barely survived the Jingnan campaign received the souls of two of the world's strongest martial artists. The First Heavenly Demon of the Demonic Cult and Huineng, the Sixth Patriarch of the Shaolin Temple in his body and was reborn as a Pacheon. 

This is where the story of the Heaven Destroyer's journey toward absolute supremacy begins! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

After working as an assistant writer for 6 years, Kim Jinwoo couldn't endure the mistreatment any longer. In the end, he boldly threw the script at his boss's face and resigned! The aftermath? Well, it's either the talk of the town among high schoolers during the girl group music bank commute or while watching it live... Here I am, being a legend with this story... 

Suddenly, a status window appears before me, and a hilarious drama story pops up in my mind! Yeah! With this ability, I can debut as a drama writer too! But... the place to write is randomly assigned?!

Lee Yoonsung and Park Dokyung grew up together in the countryside since they were young. Yoonsung became an actor by chance, but whenever he has time, he travels back and forth between Seoul and his hometown to see Dokyung, his first and unrequited love. 

Dokyung cared for Yoonsung, who had cried a lot since he was young. Yoonsung finds himself developing stronger feelings for Dokyung, and his body's responses are becoming more noticeable. Fearing that his feelings would be exposed, Yoonsung tries not to show and resolves to remain at least a friend...

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

description:
Heo Jeong-U, a high school student who is bullied by a girl in his class for his weakness. Han Bo-Ra, a transfer student, comes to Jeong-U's class, where he was spending his miserable days. Jeong-U feels a strong sense of déjà vu when he sees the child with straight black hair and stains on his legs. Sure enough, Han Bo-Ra, who has subdued the arguing classmates, asks them, "Have you ever seen a child similar to me?" Jeong-U decides to approach Bo-Ra, who might be able to correct what is wrong...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kim Ju-Won was forcibly dragged into this world by the system and became a hero. After five years of hard work, he finally succeeded in defeating the Demon King, but due to a breakdown in the transmission device, he was unable to return to Earth for the next ten days. Ju-Won, who was trying to organize his life in this world for the rest of his time, collapses due to accumulated fatigue and is admitted to a hospital in the city… He meets the nurses Catty and Miyo, and a patient with a familiar face from the next room…

Ten days until I return to Earth, happy times with them are about to begin in a small hospital room.

A normal (?) office worker who’s fine after jacking off fifteen times in a row was summoned to another world. Who he met up with was not a goddess, but a demon lord? Plus, if he wants to return to his original world, he has to make the hero fall, something even the demon lord couldn’t do?!

กระต่ายอย่างผม 3 วิก็ไม่ไหวแล้ว

description:
After failing the auditions for a role he'd been preparing for, Lyle takes a trip to Korea for a change of pace. As a black-footed cat-man, he was not able to present himself as a top amongst the larger beastmen, but having travelled to this place with all sorts of small and cute animals that suited his tastes, he thinks he could be a top here. After downloading an online dating app, Lyle starts chatting with a rabbit-man with the handle "Kkyu," and steadily grows fond of him. Finally, the day they meet arrives! However, what appears before Lyle, as his heart pounds, is...a brute-like rabbit...?! 

*"Is this person...really my Kkyu...?!"* 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

description:
In the martial arts novel Return of the Hero, Ha Yun is a school graduate who is possessed by the weakling Chou Yun. Believing that a child deserves to be protected, he picks up the final boss of the original story, the future martial arts master Sae-baek, and the preface Tian-oh. He curiously twisted the flow of the original story and was relieved that he could now raise them well and send them out into society. 

"I want to rip out all their heads." 

Is this what it means to be a Murim?! Even a child can't help but dream of revenge after experiencing persecution?! The words that came out of the mouth of a seven-year-old child were brutal, and I thought I should respond with adult morals.... 

"Do what you want. Create the most brutal martial art in the world, or take revenge with it." 

Nothing works. In this story, a young man who has been patched up by a martial artist, only spits out stern words, and his students turn away from his work without even trying.

Bobong wants to be a painter, Jin dreams of being an interior designer, and Po aims to be the best patissier! The story of three friends who came to the city with their own dreams.

A world where there are "superpowers," a new race of humans who surpass human abilities, and "guides" who can control their rampage. Betty, a guide, hides her identity and lives in a small town in America. One day, James, a super-powered hero, transfers to Betty's school to find the villain "Dave." Betty avoids James but continues to become involved with him. And to make matters worse, while trying to stop her best friend's rampage of superpowers, she is forced to use her guide abilities... It turns out that her friend is not an ordinary superpower, but a villain. It was Dave! Betty is caught between a villain and a hero, and her life, which she wanted to live normally, begins to spiral.

(Source: Naver, translated)

But Woo-gyeom, who I met again after 9 years, is a bit strange. He asked me to pretend to be his girlfriend and then kissed me right away. Now he says he wants to be my real boyfriend. Lee Yoonhae, a first-year college student, is a gay man secretly in love with a male classmate. But his hidden feelings are accidentally discovered by another classmate, Cha Geonhyeok.

*“Want to sleep with me?”*

Unable to refuse Geonhyeok’s proposal, Yoonhae ends up in a casual arrangement where the two have sex about once a week. As they spend more time together, Yoonhae opens up to Geonhyeok about his crush in detail and asks for help in getting closer to him. Though annoyed, Geonhyeok starts helping him anyway.

*“What are you going to do knowing that?”  
“I have dinner plans.”*

But suddenly, Geonhyeok’s attitude changes, and he begins avoiding Yoonhae. From that point on, Yoonhae finds himself thinking more about Geonhyeok than his original crush…

Will Yoonhae’s unrequited love ever come true?

What does it mean to be "kind" as people think?

Sun-Hae hates being called "kind." Ever since childhood, people have inexplicably labeled her as kind. She doesn’t understand why they say that when she’s never done anything particularly kind.

Thanks to this societal brainwashing, Sun-Hae even chose her career as a social worker. One day, she woke up and realized she had ended up this way without really deciding it herself.

As a result, she hears that dreaded word, "kind," countless times at work as well. People use the word to take advantage of her.

But deep down, Sun-Hae has always wanted to reject this label. She knows exactly what people mean when they call someone "kind."

Being "kind," she understands, is just a polite way of calling someone a naive pushover.

Meet the unforgettable one-night stand partner again as your boss!

Three years ago, when she went down to Daebok Resort to attend her mother's wedding, she kept running into a man. Yumi bumped into a man whose name she didn't even know, and ended up spending the night with him, caught up in the atmosphere. The next day, Yumi panicked and ran away, and Jinwook, the man who had feelings for Yumi, felt betrayed by her disappearance. Three years passed without even knowing each other's names... Yumi joined Daebok Group, a large domestic company, as a nutritionist. But... the general manager... the man from three years ago...?! Yumi and Jinwook met at the same company as the general manager and nutritionist, as if by a twist of fate. Jinwook, who recognized Yumi, designates her as the nutritionist in charge. Yumi's thrillingly delicious romance where she has to make a dish that suits Jinwook's taste, who has changed from a dreamy one-night stand to a slightly(?) darkened boss!

The hometown I had suddenly returned to did not welcome me back. A sudden downpour of rain. An old house with a leaky ceiling. I went to a guest house that towered over the shabby place and asked for help. No, I begged.

I asked for a room from a guesthouse owner, who said he wasn't in business, but I didn't realize at the time that I was about to be pressed into a corner.

"I know you. You're Ai Ying, Grandma Chunyeo's granddaughter."

"How do you know?"

Somehow I ended up speaking with him and eating his food, after hearing him mention my grandmother. The more I got to know him, the more I felt an unexplainable emotion.

"Do you want to sleep with me?"

“How come?”
“Where neither love is given nor received, why stay in such a marriage?”*

Handshakes were exchanged, and with each passing step, Amelia drew closer to her liberation. But this man... was he always this sweet?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*
The story of a cursed woman and a cursed man.

“Whether you are unhappy or happy, live next to me and die next to me.”

Don’t understand or forgive me.  
You just have to love me.

‘Why did I look so pretty to him? I wish I hadn’t been noticed.’

He was darkness and light, despair and hope.  
I can’t forget the moment I saw his face with my eyesight restored.

A fatal love that blooms amid misunderstanding and truth, obsession and revenge.  
The face of ‘that man’ who doesn’t matter as long as it’s not ‘that person’  
is imprinted.


**Original Webtoon:**  
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4562000735), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10319617), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/engraved_), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000060161), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/64059269)

"Survive? I'm just a little Maltese!"

Ppiyong was living a cozy, carefree life in a warm home with her loving sister—until one day, her family and all the humans suddenly disappeared. She's never done anything on her own before—will she find a way to survive in a city overrun by zombie dogs and reunite with her sister?

(Source: Naver, translated)

I’ve heard of epilepsy, but epilepsy?

As a second-year middle school student in a rural town, during a time when I was at my most sensitive, epilepsy, an unwelcome guest, suddenly arrived. Plagued by a barrage of medication side effects, and branded with the label “the kid who has seizures,” I had to live my days surrounded by misunderstanding and prejudice. 

A chaotic, headlong account of my battle with epilepsy, as I navigate daily life while facing this unfamiliar disease! (With a bit of information thrown in, though).

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

description:
Being an Elite Nanny is simple: protect the charge, obey the principle, and don’t get emotionally attached. Easier said than done when Davina’s first client is a dangerously compelling Venetian underboss who’s determined to get under her skin. What he wants from her, she can’t imagine, but Gabriel Angelini drags her back into the glittering world of organized crime she thought she’d left behind forever. She might get answers about her past if she digs deep enough, but can she protect Mikey from his father’s ambitions and keep her heart from getting tangled up in their treacherous web?

[Original Webtoon](https://www.webtoons.com/en/romance/the-mafia-nanny/list?title_no=5879)

For those who love LGBTQIA+ romance and slice-of-life stories, this is a comic about four college students who begin a polyamorous relationship and navigate the adventure that is their dating life.

For those who love LGBTQIA+ romance and slice-of-life stories, this is a comic about four college students who begin a polyamorous relationship and navigate the adventure that is their dating life. 

Boyfriends. is one of the most popular romance titles on the WEBTOON platform.

Boys, sweet boys! 

Boyfriends. is the polyamorous story of a jock, a nerd, a prep, and a goth who are learning to love one another and make a four-person relationship work in their own sweet way. Through navigating the adventures of dating life, the boyfriends come to understand themselves and each other better.

The boys have just taken a huge step: moving in together! This means some major milestones for the polycule, like learning how to share a space, cooking for one another, and finding a dream couch that will fit all four of them. As their polyam relationship matures, the guys also work through some insecurities, evolve their understandings of gender, and learn about expressing and accepting love.

There’s always plenty of space for joy when the boyfriends are together though, from cuddling, to gaming, to anime conventions, to competing to be the ultimate malewife.

Laugh-out-loud funny and always heartwarming, Boyfriends. is filled to the brim with moments of pride big and small.

Collects episodes 149–200 of the delightful WEBTOON comic Boyfriends.

[WEBTOON ](https://m.webtoons.com/en/slice-of-life/boyfriends/list?title_no=2616&webtoon-platform-redirect=true)

1627; A young, noble and penniless man rides towards Paris. The impetuous d'Artagnan harbors a single dream: to become a Musketeer of the King and thus join an elite corps symbolizing prestige and heroism. By a twist of fate, he will cross paths with three valiant companions in arms: Athos, Porthos, and Aramis, known as the Three Musketeers! In the realm of Louis XIII, conspiracy reigns. Catholics strive to retain their power against Protestants, the English are perceived as a threat, and the Musketeers must thwart the schemes of the powerful Cardinal de Richelieu and his elusive accomplice, Milady de Winter. But don't they say that strength lies in unity? The Three Musketeers have made it their motto: "One for all... all for one!"

*Source: FairSquare Graphics, Vol. 1*

Kéli is a headstrong teenager who dreams of only one thing: undergoing the Katafali ritual to become a man in the eyes of his tribe. However, the young boy struggles to fully embrace his people’s peaceful philosophy, as well as the wise counsel of his elders... That’s when Anansi, the sorcerer, has a vision of the apocalypse: the village is about to be invaded by strangers endowed with a mysterious and deadly power! The clan members now face a dilemma: how can they defend themselves against this enemy when their beliefs demand nonviolence? Is this Kéli’s chance to prove his worth? A bold modern fusion of manga and the ancestral tales of African griots, RedFlower is an action-adventure shonen that will sweep you into the explosive clash of two opposing cultures—one steeped in animism and spirituality, the other for whom the end justifies the means. All while exploring the same central question: is it our actions or their consequences that make us adults?

*Source: Glénat*

The blossoming love between Haneul, a webcomic artist, and her new female assistant, Boram!

Source: [WEBTOON](https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/be-my-muse-gl/list?title_no=852984)

The future has grown into a decadent, overcrowded gang-ridden cesspool. If you’re not living uptown, you might as well be dead. Such is the case of Darius Smith, an artistic youth living in the hood, doing his best to avoid trouble and live life. Unfortunately, Darius has a hidden talent — he’s an explosive fighter! This makes him the target of several gangs and pits him in many brawls, landing him in the sight of the honorable Timothy Mustafa, a powerful prince.

XOGENASYS is a successful gladiator sport fought with powered exoskeletons, and as the owner of one of the most successful teams in the country, Mustafa wants Darius to become his newest fighter. Can Darius become the next champion? Or will he fall like so many before him?

Azula continues her destabilizing campaign against the Fire Nation and her brother, Fire Lord Zuko.
But after a failed attack on her latest target, Azula finds herself in a mysterious forest temple inhabited by a solitary monk…or is it something more mysterious? Azula must confront her past, and finally face her chance at redemption.

description:
Jack Skellington is the undisputed Pumpkin King of Halloween Town. But it wasn't always that way...

Years ago, Jack and Oogie Boogie were close friends. Both eager to prove themselves, they poured all their passion into their fantastical projects to earn their rightful place as the scariest duo in town. But there could only be one Pumpkin King! What could have happened to turn two best friends into such bitter rivals?

[ Official English](https://comics.inkr.com/title/2263-the-nightmare-before-christmas-the-battle-for-pumpkin-king?utm_source=mud)

An ordinary boy yearns to live a simple life, but an extraordinary event unfolds, forever altering his mundane existence into an extraordinary adventure.

titles.title: School Memories: The Memories that Shape Our Lives

description:
"School Memories" by Sharean Morishita is a powerful and thought-provoking manga that explores the impact of bullying and the importance of compassion.

This all-ages webcomic follows the lives of two school students, Colton, the class clown and Echo, the school new girl who has been a victim of bullying at every new school she has attended.

When Colton's well-intentioned joke goes wrong, he realizes the impact his actions can have on others and begins to understand the importance of empathy and kindness.

With stunning illustrations and a touching story, "School Memories" is a must-read for anyone who wants to understand the power of empathy and compassion.

Sharean Morishita's manga provides a powerful message that will leave you inspired and uplifted, and serves as a reminder of the impact our words and actions can have on others.

Get your copy today and join Colton and Echo on their journey of self-discovery and growth.

Namiko is a naive mermaid with a pink tail, flowing silver hair, and the most beautiful voice. It is her dream to sing of love and hope to her beloved Eiji, a member of ExciTe, a Japanese pop-duo who happens to be searching for a special maiden. Following the melody beset by her dreams of romance, Namiko flies from the Atlantic region to Japan. Despite chasing this personal love-story, Namiko carries with her the divine commission given to all Merpeople by The Father of Love with her.

The human world declines more and more as it slips further and further into the influence of the Shadows, causing humans to forget love and seek decadent independence which is the source of the world's chaos. Merpeople are commissioned to sing to all humans, teaching them of true love and a coming new world of peace. However, the queen of Shadows, Lady Sin and her warriors seek to eradicate all Merpeople along with their songs to preserve the current world and advance human progression. By gathering "Progeny", humans who embrace shadows, Lady Sin seeks to awaken the "Heir to the Light Bearer" who will revive an ancient kingdom, sealing the fate of the world's future.

Upon arriving in Japan, after an unexpected chance to meet her beloved Eiji being squandered, Namiko meets a mysterious traveling music conductor and a dapper owl named Oliver. During their exchange, she is gifted a special pearl of divine power and is revealed to be Pearl Maiden, the one who will seal away the Shadows.

Namiko takes on her mission with a wistful reluctance as the mysterious songs of ExciTe tug at her very soul. Not knowing that Eiji and his partner Teppei hold deep secrets of their own, Namiko is teased with constant chances of the long-awaited rendezvous as the peridot-eyed celebrity reaches out to her. However, the enemy continues to advance, rapidly coming ever closer to awakening the Heir who will transform the world into an empire of shadows.
With the future of the world at stake, Namiko must ask herself a question to which the answer seals the fate of the world: "What's more important: Her love? Or her Duty?"

Rivals-turned-lovers Peony and Silkrose finally set out on their long-awaited honeymoon, but the awakening of a powerful new Battle Princess threatens to tear the two apart for good! Meanwhile, in an alternate universe, Dianthus and Silkrose reluctantly join forces to put on the perfect party for their princess, but will they be able to hold it together with Peony’s affections on the line?

Akihiko Shiraishi has it all: perfect grades, a talent for sports, and a charismatic smile. In reality, however, he's an awkward mess doing his best to meet expectations. To top it off, he's forced to compete with Harumi Kurose, a young prodigy from a rival school. Harumi is known to be cold and intimidating, so when their paths cross, Akihiko learns he may not the only one putting up a façade. Could their relationship bloom into something more?

(Source: Webtoon)

When you notice a pretty stranger on the streets, chances are you’ll never meet them again. You’ll just walk by and continue your normal flow of life… Axel’s pipe dream of seeing his pretty stranger again is, for better or worse, met with an extra package.

When a fame-obsessed boy named Chase finds a key that allows him to walk into any storybook and take the place of a character in it, he’s offered a chance to earn a wish for anything he wants. The only catch? He's always the heroine! Meanwhile, other forces are searching for his key...especially Chase’s rival, a handsome but malicious young man in possession of another key, who is determined to kick Chase out of the storybook biz for good.

(Source: Webtoon)

WARNING: MATURE THEMES| A girl obsessed with true crimes dates a guy she suspects to be a psychopath. Finn dates Isaac, a man she suspects of being a psychopath. Playing cat and mouse games with each other, they will soon unravel a bloody truth linking both of them to the serial killings happening in the city.

Jasper meets Kai, a boy who doesn't speak. Will they find a way to communicate the feelings they both have? 

(Source: Webtoons)

display_title: Achilles and the Boy Next Door
mangabaka_title: Achilles and the Boy Next Door

titles.title: Achilles and the Boy Next Door

description:
Achilles, warrior of legend, has swallowed the reality that his glory days are over. Now, he’s just Adrian, the physical therapist — and all he wants these days is his paycheck and the privacy to nurse his permanent limp in peace! But his quiet life is interrupted when his rowdy and adventurous new neighbor ends up being Harper, a super hot advice columnist and NuTuber with an uncanny ability to know what people are thinking. As the two clash, sparks fly; is it possible for a man who’s lived a thousand lifetimes to fall in love again? More pressingly, can Achilles survive being the influencer’s new camera guy?!
Source: Tapas

The Netherworld: A world inhabited only by Demons, creatures born from the dark abyss. For Salvos, a curious newborn Demon with a penchant for making friends, surviving this hellish landscape was always going to be a difficult task.

And when her companion's life is threatened by a mysterious Demon King, she'll have to adapt, gain experience, and evolve to do what it takes to save him. Even if it means separating from him and being tossed into an unfamiliar world with Humans, monsters, and a bright blue sky where she is scorned for being born a Demon.

After all, the law of evolution is survival of the fittest, and Salvos will survive.

(Source: Tapas)

Where do our souls travel when we dream? For the boy named Spider, dream worlds become reality when Nightmares come to steal the soul of the one he loves. Crossing dimensions to get her back, Spider must navigate a tricky web of fates as he joins the dreamwalkers.
Source: Webtoon

Shen Yuhua is a disappointment to the Grand Chaoyang Palace Sect, with no powers or great beauty, she brings nothing to the table for her immortal father. That all changes one day when she accidentally meets Chu Tian, the famed Demon of a Thousand Faces, her father's arch nemesis... and accidentally frees him from his prison.

(Source: Tapas)

Working hard is supposed to take you far - but into the world of your best friend's novel? For Lucy, being whisked into a life of ballrooms and picnics isn't exactly what it's cracked up to be; at least, not when everyone has mistaken her for the villain flagged for death. To escape this fate, Lucy must transform from modern workaholic to high society schemer if she even has a chance at returning home. Will she make it? Or will this world of beautiful outfits, strawberry desserts, and dashingly handsome gentlemen seal her fate?
Source: Webtoon

display_title: The Beginning After The End - Side Story - Jasmine: Wind-Borne
