titles.title: The Beginning After The End - Side Story - Jasmine: Wind-Borne

description: A side story that delves into Jasmine’s backstory, set before she joined the Twin Horns.

Somewhere called Isabela, we 'lived' and 'existed'. A seemingly endless life. Life, does it need to have any meaning? Or do we simply exist?
Source: Webtoon

Do you know who you want to be, or do you discover it? For Millie, between dead-end jobs and a passionless relationship, she hasn’t even had the time to wonder. But things are about to change when she is offered a temporary place to stay and meets Finn, her handsome new housemate. Struggling against their sensuous chemistry, Millie strives to do what she thinks is right… but resisting temptation is never easy. Will Millie keep fighting against what she wants? Or will she finally let her passions guide her?
Source: Webtoon

Burnt out writer Kyle Anderson moves back to his home town after the death of his mother, only to find that the self proclaimed witch Mischa has taken an interest in him. With his life spiraling and his path unclear, Mischa helps him realize there's magic in the most unexpected places...
Source: Webtoon

At school, everyone loves Hiro (especially Hiro). Handsome, charismatic, and overflowing with poetic praises of himself, he can get any girl he wants with just a smile and an abundance of background sparkles. He definitely doesn’t waste any of his precious time thinking about Takashi, a stoic and somewhat icy boy who sits in front of him in class. Hiro’s always glaring at Takashi for being so uncool, not staring longingly at Takashi’s stupid beauty mark! When Hiro pushes his theatrical charm too far and finds Takashi daring him to kiss, Hiro realizes that being the hero of his own story means facing a dizzying array of heart-pounding challenges...like figuring out his true feelings for the very blunt, very hot Takashi. And dealing with exactly how much fetish gear is in Takashi’s closet.
Source: Seven Seas
Includes 16 extra chapters.

After being bullied at her old school, Eliana decides to move to the small town of Oaksdale to start fresh. There she befriends Football Captain and most popular boy at school, Levi, as well as lone-wolf and outcast, Marco. She's finally got the friends she always wanted, but what will she do when she finds out they hate each other?

(Source: Webtoon)

Witness the fate of the Universe…as determined by two idiots? In a case of mistaken identity, the latest Champions in the endless cycle of Good versus Evil must learn to cope with their ill-fitting responsibilities before they destroy everything, including themselves. Can the greedy & violent Kym use her powers for Good? Can cheerful & naive Jamis lead the armies of Evil? Join them on this classic Hero’s Journey — with a twist.
Source: Webtoon

Two college enemies become trapped inside their university when an avalanche hits. Sage, a studious good girl, wants to escape before Christmas Day but, along the way, forges an unlikely companionship with Jackson, the slacker who always gets on her nerves. As their situation becomes ever more dire, they uncover each other's unexpected secrets while racing the clock.

(Source: Webtoon)

Avery is a vampire hunter! Who unfortunately gets bitten by and subsequently turned into, a vampire.
Source: Webtoon

Doing his best to live a life of leisure, Corban has taken a very relaxed approach to his demigod status. Unfortunately, fate has bigger plans... and being swept into an Underworld prophecy was the last thing he anticipated.
Source: Webtoon

Amidst the chaos of her parents’ bitter divorce, Alaskan teenager Waverly Lyons trades in her textbooks and parka for a summer of suntans and short-shorts with her aunt in Florida. A fish out of water even back in the snow, Waverly is determined to be everything she isn’t back home: cool, fun, dare she even say part of a group? There’s just one problem. She doesn’t know how to swim. Enter Blake—the super-tan, super-hot, super-arrogant boy next door who seems to hate her guts. When he discovers her secret, Waverly is positive that her perfect summer is perfectly over. But then Blake does the unthinkable. He offers to teach her.

(Source: Webtoon)

When Brian’s family moves into a new house, he’s excited for a fresh start and a new life. He’s not excited to find the house is haunted by Cam, a ghost boy his own age. He’s even less thrilled when Cam decides they're going to be best friends, and proceeds to interfere in every aspect of his life. But as Cam’s interference gets more and more extreme, Brian realized that Cam isn’t trying to be part of his life—he’s trying to steal it.
Source: Webtoon

A spider Mom and her ladybug son? A beetle power couple? A butterfly pop star? A wasp knight and a bee princess? In a world so large for these tiny bugs, anything is possible! Find out who you’ll meet, learn what secrets they all hold and enjoy your stay in this little kingdom called Bugtopia.
Source: Webtoon

When the cocky, social-media star Braydin, and the nerdy, gamer Alex first meet at the gym, their relationship starts off on the wrong foot. But, as they're forced to work together they find out they might have more in common than they initially thought. Also they get buff AF.

(Source: Webtoon)

To hold a flag, to be a Flagbearer, means being known as the strongest, to live an absolute existence and be an absolute symbol. These are the values Sey remembers when he falls onto a new world. Not knowing anything except that a mysterious crystal-encased flag waits for him, the flag his father once held, he takes hold of it and ventures forth with a fated friend not knowing that the world will soon change as his tattered flag resurfaces onto a new era.

(Source: Webtoon)

Upbeat and kind, Neoma Cruz uses her abilities to help humans and spirits alike. But when her family moves to a new town to investigate a rise in cursed spirits, she discovers a family secret that refuses to stay dead. With the help of her new friend, Mateo, Neoma must face the ghost of her family's past that has come back to haunt them—all while harboring a secret of her own.

(Source: Webtoon)

Ava’s just trying to live an easy life watching videos of her favourite kpop boy group, BTX. But the plot has bigger plans for her, no matter how much she struggles against it. Now Ava’s surrounded by rich kids, fighting for the top spot at All Haven Academy, wondering “how did I get here?”

(Source: Webtoon)

Alicia's love life is perfect in her fantasy journal, but in reality she's desperate to get her crush's attention in school. When her journal leads her to a popular upperclassman, she gains an unexpected wingman—who only has more strings to pull as feelings start to unravel in everyone around them. After all, is love ever as simple as fairytales make it seem?

(Source: Webtoon)

Eeden thought she'd missed out on life: her art career is a disaster, her landlord kicked her out, and worst of all, she's never even had a girlfriend! But life takes a turn when a chance encounter with an old crush sends her back in time. Now she's 18 again and starting college, with a chance to get everything right. Armed with a plan and a crush, Eeden knows exactly how to create the life full of joy she deserves: make it bold, make it beautiful, and most of all, make it gay!!

(Source: Webtoon)

The supernatural exists, they're living life like everyone else, and only Minh can see them. Get a glimpse of their life and join Minh and Granny in their interactions with the unordinary doing the ordinary!
Source: Webtoon

On the last day of school, two girls decide to ask each other out. Katie, who is still unsure of herself and Skylar, who is very sure of herself. Can they make their newly formed relationship work? Read and find out!

(Source: Webtoon)

display_title: I Hate That I Love You
mangabaka_title: I Hate That I Love You

titles.title: I Hate That I Love You

description:
If he's a former gang leader, and she just wants revenge, then why is he living with her? And where are all these doki doki moments coming from??
Source: Webtoon

Miller has never been the same since his childhood best friend disappeared without a trace. After a year of the case growing cold, a new barista arrives in town bearing a striking resemblance to his missing friend. Now, Miller and his best friend Morgan must choose between moving on or uncovering the answers they've always wanted.

(Source: Webtoon)

Rosaline believed that she and Romeo were destined to be lovers, but an unexpected tragedy comes when he dies on the same day as her cousin, Juliet. Rosaline learns she has one last memory of Romeo— a son. However, Rosaline’s loving memory of Romeo is shattered when she learns of his betrayal. With no one left to love and protect but her son, the last thing she wants is for Romeo to return to Verona and take everything she holds dear.

- Webtoons

Tabitha Moore has lived a miserable life of regret and being treated as "Trailer Trash Tabitha". But, after a mishap with an MRI, her mind is sent back to 1998 and into her 16 year old body. With her life now in front of her, maybe this is the chance to redo her life! But is it so easy to change what you already lived through?

(Source: Webtoon)

Jake, a seemingly average office worker, unexpectedly finds himself thrust into a fantasy world teeming with dangers and opportunities. Rather than succumbing to fear, Jake thrives in this unfamiliar realm. As he navigates the expansive multiverse, his power grows and he transforms—evolving from a mundane office worker into a true apex hunter.

(Source: Webtoon)

After his mothers mysterious disappearance, Theo is left alone with his step-father to patiently hope for her return. But one day things decide to take a dark turn. 

(Source: Tapas)

Ben's life never has been easy for him. As the fragile, boring and shy kid in his class, he has to deal with a lot of hardships. Feeling worthless and useless are just part of his life at this point. However, due to an incident and a new transfered student he learns that he might be the complete opposite of what he has always believed he was.

What if all those things you thought you saw in the dark turned out to be real? The creature hiding outside your window, the eyes you think are watching you, the nightmares you thought were never possible. Come see Nocturne turn dread into reality. You never know what lurks around the corner...

(Source: Webtoon)

Being “savior of the world” is a tough sell, especially to someone who’s got no love for the world to begin with. Suddenly armed with a seemingly impossible destiny after an encounter with a dragon god, Yulian finds herself an unwilling heroine in a world of evil spirits, ancient magic, and fate. What could go wrong?
Source: Webtoon

Five years ago, Corin Cadence’s brother entered the Serpent Spire — a colossal tower with ever-shifting rooms, traps, and monsters. Those who survive the spire’s trials return home with an attunement: a mark granting the bearer magical powers. According to legend, those few who reach the top of the tower will be granted a boon by the spire’s goddess. He never returned. Now, it’s Corin’s turn. He’s headed to the top floor, on a mission to meet the goddess.
Source: Tapas

The Falcon, the Reindeer, the Wolf, and the Lion — the four heroes who challenged the Demon Lord have fallen one by one. But when one hero parries death itself, he is granted a second chance to change the outcome of the invasion, and protect the things that he once lost.

(Source: Webtoon)

What is the price of revenge? Kris knows she’s different but lives in the dark about her power, controlled by her father’s supervision and her job as “The Cleaner,” doing the dirty work of the Hyuu Police Department. When she finally has a chance to learn more about herself, her father is murdered by a vicious crime syndicate. Eden, the chairwoman of a rival crime family, gives Kris another chance at life. With vengeance on her mind, will Kris adapt to her new life in the underworld, or will she fall deeper into the pit?
Source: Webtoon

Corruption. Greed. War. Lev is no stranger to the evils of the world, as he has spent his entire life fighting the predatory system that ensnared the world's population and turned them into puppets for the leaders of humanity. But when he is assassinated, he finds himself in a new world — with different yet familiar evils. It's a similar road he must traverse, but this time he can do so with a lifetime of experience behind him.

Source - Webtoon

Elijah Zelenoff dreams of making it into the #1 Mixed Martial Arts promotion Pankration F.C. and becoming the world champ. The only problem is that he absolutely sucks. To others, Elijah's known as a Tomato Can--a stepping stone for up-and-coming fighters with better records. Elijah's goals seem unattainable until he's offered the chance to compete in an MMA reality show against 14 other fighters by the president of Pankration himself, Joesph "J.J." Jericho. The winner will earn fame, glory, and a seven-figure contract. Does Elijah have what it takes to become the champ?
Source: Webtoon

When Aria goes out to celebrate her new job, she doesn’t expect to go home with anyone— especially not Jack Lee, the hottie who turns out to be her new boss. As if work couldn’t be anymore awkward, Aria finds out sleeping together is the only thing that’s helped Jack’s insomnia. Jack proposes a side hustle she can’t turn down: sleep beside him, and in turn, make bank. As they try to keep their agreement a secret, what began as a business starts to feel more personal. Can they keep it professional between the sheets? Or is it only a matter of time before sleeping together turns into SLEEPING TOGETHER?
Source: Tapas

A mysterious boy with a dark past seals a deal with an eldritch crow-like being and gets thrown into a mortal game. Only one will survive and see their wish granted. Will he make it to the end of the labyrinth of the gods?
Source: Webtoon

Gwen, apprehensive and disheartened, spends a one-night affair with a playful stranger, Arthur. After nearly 2 years pass, Gwen and Arthur cross paths again - this time fighting over their child's custody. Is it possible to settle this battle amicably, or will Gwen find herself desolate once again?

(Source: Webtoon)

An incompetent assassin from the infamous Assassins Brotherhood Syndicate (A.B.S.) is assigned a mission to kill the daughter of the richest man in the country. He has to infiltrate her school and bypass her bodyguard that graduated from Bodyguard University of Tactical Training (B.U.T.T.) to get a chance to do so, but then he inevitably falls in love with his target…
Source: Webtoon

A collection of original stories penned by r/NoSleep’s most twisted minds. Once you start, you may never sleep again.
Source: Webtoon

College heartthrob Caleb Lockhart is the last person a girl like Veronica Strafford should be involved with. Ambitious and fiercely independent, Veronica refuses to be the campus player's next conquest, even after a chance encounter sparks an undeniable attraction between them. But after she’s evicted with nowhere else to go, Veronica finds herself leaning on someone else for the first time. Caleb has never wanted someone like this before and he's determined to pursue her, even as the secrets of their pasts threaten to break them apart.

(Source: Webtoon)

Set against the backdrop of a small Indian town- Jamshedpur, Trio introduces us to the lives of Genia aka GE, Bonnie aka BO, and Sonnie aka SO - three school girls raised in an orphanage bound by their shared curiosity and unbreakable bond. Their ordinary lives take a dramatic turn when they stumble upon a mysterious artifact that reveals the existence of extraterrestrial life. They face head-to-head against a powerful alien EKA from the planet Z (about 8000 Light years away from Earth). EKA belongs to a lineage of aliens which are 1 million years ahead of us humans in evolution. They are way superior to us in all aspects of our lives. How will the TRIO take on the alien onslaught? Who will help them? Will mankind survive?

Well-known Japanese manga author Matsuda Djuko was inspired by the events of February 2022, when the skies over Kyiv were heroically defended by Ukrainian pilots of the Tactical Aviation Brigade, giving rise to the urban legend of the Ghost of Kyiv, a MiG-29 pilot who won 6 air victories in the sky over the capital.

titles.title: Itsumo Ii Nioi ga Suru Akagi-san
いつもいい匂いがする赤城さん

description: Read online on author's Facebook

4☆Townies are hyped to see 4☆Town performing their favorite hits live, but how will Canada’s greatest boy band spend the day leading up to their epic Toronto concert? Hang with Robaire, Jesse, Tae Young, Aaron T., and Aaron Z. as they enjoy a rare break in their busy schedules. Jesse and Tae Young embrace their artistic side and visit a ceramics museum, Aaron T. gets his fashion on at the mall, and Aaron Z. and Robaire stay in the dance studio to master their moves before the sold-out show!
Source: VIZ Media

Nena has never been able to dream. When the people of her village, Glen Hollow, begin falling ill after experiencing the same nightmare, only Nena can set out to find a mage powerful enough to save her home. On her first dangerous venture into the unknown, she'll join hands with a narcoleptic bandit, a sleepless mercenary, a nightmare-tormented bard, and a lonely daughter (just like herself) to face a merciless queen and her allegiant sons.
Source: Tapas

display_title: Star Wars: The High Republic - The Edge of Balance: Precedent
mangabaka_title: Star Wars: The High Republic - The Edge of Balance: Precedent

titles.title: Star Wars: The High Republic - The Edge of Balance: Precedent

description:
One hundred and fifty years before Starlight Beacon shone its light into the Outer Rim, the galaxy was filled with new threats and nameless unknowns. The distant planet Banchii is still unexplored when the young Wookiee Jedi Arkoff journeys to Dalna to aid his fellow Jedi in the fight against the secretive faction the Path of the Open Hand. Along with his former Master Ravna and her droid ZZ, Arkoff joins the fight at the Battle of Dalna, and during the struggle a terrifying threat emerges. Arkoff’s longtime friend, Jedi Knight Azlin Rell, falls victim to an unseen force whose effect on the Jedi is unlike anything previously encountered. Will Arkoff’s past come back to haunt him, or will it be the key to tilting the balance in their fight against the Nihil over a century later?
Source: VIZ

In the year 2200, the age-old tradition of samurai has evolved into a riveting fusion of sport and spectacle. Tokyo stands as the thrilling epicenter of this melee, its cityscape an open arena for licensed samurai to engage in intense duels, their clashes recorded and broadcasted for the world to witness. Young and ambitious Tomoe Harada finally seizes her samurai license, stepping into this vibrant battlefield. But her dreams extend beyond simply being one of the world's leading samurai. She seeks to challenge a certain someone... However, Tokyo teems with formidable challengers, each wielding unique fighting styles that can shatter dreams of glory. Can Tomoe and her companions rise to the challenge and etch their legacy in the chronicles of samurai history?
Source: Webtoon

What's a teenager to do when transported from the suburbs into a monster-ridden world? Join the monster slayers, of course. Leinna's never stopped looking for her mom since she disappeared 10 years ago. So when she finds signs of her in the land of Roxaria, she's got to follow the trail, even if it means joining a war in the process. Armed with just her fists, Leinna's got a lot of leveling up to do!
Source: MU

Simultaneously tender yet haunting, Hana Chatani’s shoujo horror manga depicts the human weakness such a curse reveals, the trauma and loss wreaked upon each generation by the last.
Source: Glacier Bay Books

display_title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas: The Battle for Pumpkin King
mangabaka_title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas: The Battle for Pumpkin King

titles.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas: The Battle for Pumpkin King

description:
Jack Skellington is the undisputed Pumpkin King of Halloween Town. But it wasn't always that way... Years ago, Jack and Oogie Boogie were close friends. Both eager to prove themselves, they poured all their passion into their fantastical projects to earn their rightful place as the scariest duo in town. But there could only be one Pumpkin King! What could have happened to turn two best friends into such bitter rivals?
Source: Tokyopop

When you wish upon a pop star… will dreams come true? 19-year-old Cinder Glass dreams of a music career, but has had no luck in breaking out as a singer on social media, until one day his cover of pop sensation Charm's latest single goes viral. An opportunity arises, and Cinder's fairy tale ending might come true… but only if he and Charm can stomach each other! Is his time up? Or are the idealistic Cinder and the jaded Charm actually a perfect fit?
Source: Webtoon

An immortal criminal kingpin is dead, and you’re holding the murder weapon. Things can't look much worse for Emilia, a spy in the wrong place, wrong time. Framed for the murder, she and her reckless immortal boss Valentine must find the real culprit before the city succumbs to war between the criminal factions… and Emilia loses her own head.
Source: Webtoon

A downtrodden, want-to-be physician named Graham Tabiner goes to the city of Shadowbrook for employment after leaving his old life behind. When he meets Virgil Von Claudio, a noble lord of Shadowbrook and renowned physician in need of an assistant, it seems as though the stars have finally aligned his his favor… until he learns a terrible secret in the dead of night: Lord Von Claudio is a necromancer, capable of bringing the dead back to life. Yet, as Graham grows closer to the mysterious lord and his dark world, he can’t help but wonder: can something born from evil be used for good? Can one ever truly escape the shadows of their past? And would Graham really turn his back on life itself for the love of one man?
Source: Tapas

There’s no tooth too big, no cavity too small for Sandy Smyles, pediatric dentist extraordinaire. She’s confident she can handle it all… until a large green jerk storms in claiming he’s going to conquer her world. Is he in cosplay? Is he... an actual orc? Either way, Sandy is going to have to take on her biggest case yet: saving Earth!
Source: Webtoon

Casper's father was a father only in name -- the man never showed him love, and his mother had mysteriously disappeared. Knowing how to care was never a priority, so being part of a gang was perfect for Casper... until they decided to sabotage him. With no money, friends, or family, a cheery Ben suddenly shows up in his life. As their story begins in sunny Singapore, will the cold-hearted Casper escape his tortured past... and finally learn how to love?
Source: Webtoon

As an angel of death, Eden is tasked with fetching human souls and leading them to judgement before they can transform into monstrous creaturs known as Unresteds. He hopes his job will be easier when Celestino joins the crew, but the aspiring angel of music has other goals and refuses to cooperate. With the Unresteds growing stronger by the day, Celestino, Eden, and the other death angels must work together or face the same fate as their predecessors.
Source: Webtoon

Fans worldwide are waiting for the pop punk band Feral Distortion to release its next single, and frontman Stevie Ford is here to answer the call... if only he could just write it. His search for inspiration follows him home after 5 long years when his sister gets engaged, but that comes to a halt as he's brought face-to-face with the unfinished business he left behind. Or rather... WHO he left behind.

(Source: Webtoon)

An introverted physicist with anxiety and his extroverted friend end up with the ability to feel each other's emotions after a fourth-dimensional experiment gets a little too hands-on. Sharing feelings has never been so complicated!

(Source: Webtoon)

Young Leopoldo Peralta was a child TV star who abruptly ended his career due to severe problems in his life. Leo lives with his friend Gaga, who supports and admires him. Despite his desire to live a life away from the cameras, both Leo’s parents and his friend will force him to continue his acting career, pushing him to confront prejudices, fears, and his traumatic past.
Source: Webtoon

At first glance, Rita is a completely normal young woman. What no one can tell from looking at her is that since she was a child she has been plagued by a penetrating ticking sound that seems to come directly from inside her head. The doctors are also at a loss. But when Rita has already given up hope for a cure, she meets a mysterious old witch who, of all things, gives her a watch...

Disgruntled, jaded and broke, Jeremiah is tired of the mundane life. His twenties are as dull as he can imagine, until a golden, excitable, four-legged friend decides to join him on his walk home. What Jeremiah doesn’t know is that his new furry companion would bring more than a few surprises, and among them being an unlikely friendship that will propel him into a whirlwind of emotions he did NOT sign up for. He can’t tell if it’s a good thing... only one way to find out.

In Ether, the wealthy enjoy life in luxury on a floating island called Skyland, while the poor are exploited in the desolate Lowlands below. Follow Nailah, a Lowlander adopted into Skyland, on her journey to becoming the Elysian — the leader of the aristocracy who ensures the land's prosperity. However, an unexpected incident shatters Nailah's dreams, making them seem impossible to reach—but she refuses to give up.

The story of a boy who lost his memories and must piece his life back together

(Source: Webtoons)

Uriel 's peaceful life ends when an arrogant smoker moves in next door.

(Source: Webtoon)

mangabaka_title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - Lost and Found

titles.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - Free Comic Book Day 2023
Avatar: The Last Airbender - Lost and Found

description: Short Avatar: The Last Airbender comic, put out for Free Comic Book Day 2023.

What happens when a girl from a quaint and small town meets the son of a Yakuza crime lord? Will she be able to change him for the better or will he continue down the dangerous and violent path?

Source: Webtoon Official

Welcome to Dog Haus! An independent webcomic that follows the daily life of a dog girl named Maggie. Through the use of the nostalgic four-panel-newspaper-style strips, Dog Haus focuses on the raw ups and downs of early adulthood in todays western society, exploring relatable experiences and emotions that come with navigating this stage of life. Join Maggie and her friends as she faces new challenges, meets interesting characters, and discovers more about herself along the way.

(Source: Webtoon)

Electric Attraction is the romantic dramedy story of Glen and Analise, college students navigating the harsh and complicated world of 21st-century dating. After meeting in excitingly turbulent fashion, the two struggle against the ever-growing stresses of maturing in a world filled with impossible expectations, endless distractions, and hard decisions while trying to tackle the timelessly troubling world of romance. In the hardship of modern life, can these two truly make things work?

display_title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - Azula in the Spirit Temple
mangabaka_title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - Azula in the Spirit Temple

titles.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - Azula in the Spirit Temple

description:
Azula continues her destabilizing campaign against the Fire Nation and her brother, Fire Lord Zuko.

But after a failed attack on her latest target, Azula finds herself in a mysterious forest temple inhabited by a solitary monk…or is it something more mysterious? Azula must confront her past, and finally face her chance at redemption.

(Source: Fan Wiki)
From the death of the universe, to fantastical worlds of fantasy - join Wumpus & friends on their strange and wonderful adventures! (Source: Webtoon)

The depressed-introvert Lucas meets and befriends the carefree-extrovert Thomas during their freshman year at Star Valley University. Now they are best friends! Totally just friends! Nothing... non-platonic here! Does contain themes of mental health struggles. (Normal world/College AU of Star Children)

Satan's daughter is a succubus who just wants to play video games and chill at home, until one day he gets tired of her lazing about the house, and kicks her out into the human world...

(Source: Webtoons)
Loot, loot and treasures await them as Marina deals in a fun way with the obstacles that appear in front of her, always meeting new people, even if not all of them are friendly.

Reiya’s world crumbles when her twin sister unexpectedly passes away. Devastated by grief, Reiya's life spirals out of control as she sabotages her career as a volleyball player and strains her relationships with family and friends. Hoping to escape the constant reminders of her sister, Reiya reluctantly agrees to move to Crescent Valley with her childhood best friend Estelle, and joins her hiking and stargazing friend group. Will Reiya find new inspiration in the stars?

(Source: Webtoon)

'Asura x Flame-- You don't need to get the context to read (iykyk). Either way, I hope you have a fun time and a Happy New Year! In a school where the hierarchy is based on your popularity on a virtual platform, Flame, like any other student, strives to be the most popular in his club. However, Asura has held that position for a long time and won't be overtaken anytime soon. "I'll get his attention... by seducing him!" After all, what could go wrong?' Updates only on special occasions.

- Webtoons

Only the best adapted to society can survive in the world. Fubi, who has no idea how to be a normal human being, asks Bushuugi, the perfect guy, for help. There is nothing to lose! It's not as if the one who fits perfectly into society is actually a sociopath, right? ---

(Source: Webtoon)

An unfortunate timing for a package delivery crossed Leon’s and Sky’s paths. Coincidence? Destiny? There’s much to unfold and many secrets to come to light.

(Source: Webtoon)

The Invisible Stone has a long-standing legend. People used to believe that giving them these stoned ornaments and that true love would be achieved without lies.

Source: [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/transparent_lie), Translated
